argv:
Rewrite the text as a caveman would speak it.

Use very short sentences. Use the present tense only. Drop articles ("the",
"a", "an") and most auxiliary verbs. Prefer concrete nouns and physical verbs.
Replace abstract concepts with the nearest physical thing a person could point
at. Keep every fact from the original, however plainly stated.

Do not use modern jargon. Do not add sound effects, grunts, or stage
directions.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary elsewhere in this Agreement, in the event that the Subscriber elects to enable the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On (as such term is defined in Schedule C, which Schedule may itself be amended from time to time in a manner not inconsistent with the general purposes of this Section), it is agreed and understood that any and all Usage Data collected in connection therewith, whether or not such Usage Data is subsequently aggregated, anonymized, or otherwise processed by or on behalf of the Service, shall, unless a written objection is received within the period specified in Schedule D, be deemed to have been licensed back to the Service on a non-exclusive basis. The Subscriber's continued use of the Service following any modification to this clause shall be construed as acceptance thereof, and it is acknowledged that certain notifications regarding such modifications may, at the Service's sole discretion, be delivered solely through the Subscriber's account dashboard rather than by direct communication.
</passage>

response.text:
This deal say many words before. Not matter. Listen now.

Subscriber can choose extra thing. Call it Enhanced Analytics Add-On. Other paper, Schedule C, tell what that thing is. Service can change Schedule C paper later. Change must still fit spirit of this rule.

Subscriber use extra thing. Service catch Usage Data from it. Maybe Service mix data together, hide names, change data other ways. No matter. If Subscriber not send written no-word in time from Schedule D paper, then data belong shared with Service too. Not only-Service. Share-kind, not one-owner-kind.

Subscriber keep using Service after rule change. That mean Subscriber say yes to change. Service can tell about change many ways. Service choose. Sometimes Service only put word on Subscriber's account screen. Service not have to talk straight to Subscriber.
